query:
/* service='personhog-replica', operation='get_distinct_ids_for_person_cursor_limit' */
                    SELECT distinct_id, version, id
                    FROM posthog_persondistinctid
                    WHERE team_id = $1 AND person_id = $2 AND is_deleted = false
                          AND id > $3
                    ORDER BY id ASC
                    LIMIT $4
